people.name: Ahijah
people.line: Prophet from Shiloh who prophesied to Jeroboam

people.name: Jeroboam
people.line: First king of the northern kingdom of Israel.

people.name: Shiloh
people.line: Israelite sanctuary and assembly point during the judges' period

translations.web: Jeroboam’s wife did so, and arose, and went to Shiloh, and came to Ahijah’s house. Now Ahijah could not see; for his eyes were set by reason of his age.
translations.bsb: Jeroboam’s wife did as instructed; she arose and went to Shiloh and arrived at Ahijah’s house. Now Ahijah could not see, for his eyes were dim because of his age.
translations.kjv: And Jeroboam's wife did so, and arose, and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. But Ahijah could not see; for his eyes were set by reason of his age.
